items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: Alpha. Oh boy, it was somethin' when they come in the bus

ctx.x: Alpha. Oh boy, it was somethin' when they come in the bus, with the two dogs and one thing and another. I think they had a maid, too. He had a maid and a chauffeur -- Louis had a chauffeur. Because Joe Glaser bought a big red Packard, a beautiful car, and had this chauffeur to drive for Louis, and he'd go on the road with Louis. Louis wouldn't ride in the car. He wouldn't ride in the car, I don't know why. He got in the bus; he piled up in the bus.
